verdict.rationale: The only evidence is one hands-on community report that a user built a backend in n8n with "scheduled and webhook-initiated tasks". That shows the product's own scheduling exists, but nothing in the pack documents a schedule or cron trigger, and it is not explicit that the schedule recurs rather than runs once. Missing for 10: first-party docs for a schedule/cron trigger, evidence of recurring interval or cron configuration, timezone and missed-run handling, and stronger independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Our manager with zero programming skills was able to build a quite complex backend using postgres and REST APIs, with scheduled and webhook-initiated tasks.
